shortDescription: Manage CLI scripts on a BIG-IP

options.name: content
options.description: The content of the script. This parameter is typically used in conjunction with Ansible's C(file) or template lookup plugins. See the examples in this documentation.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the script.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition on which to manage resources.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the script exists. When C(absent), ensures the script is removed.
